instrument.turnedAway: {count, plural, one {# person turned away} other {# people turned away}}

noShow.consequence: Records that they did not arrive and frees the seat. You can put them back while the seat is still free.
noShow.sailedConsequence: The boat left without them. They get no recap and the day will not count for them. You can put them back.
noShow.undoAriaLabel: Put {name} back on this boat’s list
noShow.waiting: {count, plural, one {# diver is waiting for this seat} other {# divers are waiting for this seat}}
noShow.rebook: Nobody is waiting. Offer {name} another day.
noShow.nothing: Nobody is waiting, and no similar departure has room for them.
noShow.money: Marking someone not here does not charge or refund anything.

turnAway.consequence: Records that you saw them and turned them away, and frees the seat. You can put them back while the seat is still free.
turnAway.line: Seen at the desk, turned away{reason, select, medical {: medical} waiver {: waiver} card {: card} age {: age} identity {: identity} payment {: payment} other {}}
turnAway.moneyMoveDoor: Move the booking to another day
turnAway.moneyRemoveDoor: Remove the booking and refund it by hand
turnAway.noWaitlist: Nobody is waiting for this seat.

sailedRebook.open: Nothing else booked · {when} has {seats, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}}

sendFailed: That didn’t send. Tap the row again.
sendFailedButton: That didn’t send. Tap it again.
offlineLabel: Offline — this board may be out of date

notice.offerUnavailable: Nothing was sent: that departure is gone or full, or they can’t book it.
notice.offerOptedOut: Nothing was sent: they turned off emails from the shop. Call them with the date.
notice.offerNotSent: Nothing was sent: there’s no email on file for them, or email isn’t set up. Call them with the date.
notice.offerSent: Offer emailed. They book the seat themselves from the link.
notice.offerAlreadySent: Already emailed in the last 24 hours. Nothing new was sent.
notice.notReady: Something changed and they can’t board yet. Their row says what’s in the way.
notice.notBookable: That booking is no longer available for check-in.
notice.alreadyCheckedIn: That diver was already checked in.
notice.notFound: That booking could not be found.
notice.staffNotFound: Your staff access could not be confirmed.
notice.invalid: Choose a diver from the list before checking in.
notice.waiverMedicalAttestation: Confirm you reviewed the medical questionnaire before recording a paper waiver, or send the digital link so the diver answers it.
notice.waiverGuardianName: The co-signer’s name is the diver’s own, so this release would show one person signing twice. Type the guardian’s name as their own ID reads it, and if the diver’s record is shorter than the diver’s ID, correct the record to match. If the two really do read exactly alike, tick the confirmation on this form and record it.
notice.waiverIdentityUnconfirmed: This seat is held until somebody confirms who this diver is, so a paper release can’t go on their record yet. Confirm it on their row, then record the release.
notice.waiverError: That paper waiver couldn’t be recorded. Try again.
notice.walkinAdded: Added to this boat’s list. Check them in on their row.
notice.walkinAddedConfirmed: Added to this boat’s list, and their confirmation is on its way.
notice.walkinAddedWaiverUndelivered: Added to this boat’s list, but their waiver wasn’t emailed. Send it or share the link from their row below.
notice.walkinAddedIdentityUnconfirmed: Added to this boat’s list, but the seat is held until you confirm it’s the same person. Confirm it on their row below before they board.
notice.noShowAlreadyBoarded: The crew boarded that diver, so they can’t be marked as not diving. Open the trip’s manifest.
notice.noShowAlreadyMissingAfterDive: The crew recorded that diver as not back aboard after a dive. Call the boat and open the trip’s manifest.
notice.noShowAlreadyMarked: That diver is already marked not here.
notice.noShowNotBooked: That seat was given up, so there is nothing to mark.
notice.noShowTripCancelled: That departure is canceled, so its guest list can’t change.
notice.noShowBeforeDeparture: That boat has not left yet, so nobody has missed it. Try again once it departs.
notice.noShowWindowClosed: That departure is too far past to mark anyone not here. Change the booking from their row instead.
notice.noShowNotMarked: That diver is not marked not here.
notice.noShowTurnedAwayDeparted: The desk turned that diver away and the boat has left, so they can’t go back on it. Open their row to remove the booking.
notice.noShowTripFull: The freed seat has already been taken, so that diver cannot go back on this boat.
notice.turnAwayAlreadyBoarded: The crew boarded that diver. Open the trip’s manifest.
notice.turnAwaySailed: The boat left with that diver checked in. Open the trip’s manifest.
notice.turnAwayOutsideWindow: That departure is outside the desk’s hours. Change the booking from their row instead.
notice.turnAwayNotBlocked: Nothing stops them boarding now. Check them in instead.
notice.turnAwayReasonNotBlocking: Their row changed. Choose a reason it shows now.
notice.noShowCourseRatioFull: That session is at its instructor-to-student ratio, so that diver can’t go back on it. Assign another instructor first.
notice.walkinPartyAdded: Everyone is on this boat’s list, together. Check them in on their rows.
notice.walkinPartyAddedWaiverUndelivered: Everyone is on this boat’s list, together, but their releases weren’t emailed. Send them or share the links from their rows below. A parent or legal guardian signs with anyone under 18.
